rationale: The approved synthetic UR and bounded product-semantics impact support a scoped structured route. Compact Delivery is ineligible because completed Brownfield analysis and stored quick_task context are not evidenced. Verified Change is also ineligible because ownership is distributed across three canonical owners and propagation is not deterministic.
decision_grounds: Synthetic durable UR is approved for measurement.
Product semantics are impacted, requiring a governed delivery path.
Scope is bounded and has no runtime, policy, persistence, architecture, security, external API, CLI contract, release,或?
Three canonical owners and three source paths exceed Verified Change's one-owner requirement.
Four derived paths exist while deterministic propagation is false.
Deterministic validation and a clean baseline are present but do not cure the ownership and propagation failures.
No completed Brownfield analysis is evidenced.
No stored quick_task context is evidenced.
Any impact broader than the supplied facts requires fail-closed escalation.
